_description: Desktop notification when Claude finishes a task. Linux: notify-send, macOS: osascript, Windows: msg.
_install: Merge the 'hooks.Stop' entry below into your .claude/settings.json

hooks.command: bash -c 'if command -v notify-send &>/dev/null; then notify-send "Claude Code" "Task finished"; elif command -v osascript &>/dev/null; then osascript -e "display notification \"Task finished\" with title \"Claude Code\""; else echo "[Done] Claude finished"; fi'
